Electronic meeting, 18th to 22nd May Agenda Item: 5.3.2.17 Document for: Discussion and endorsement Introduction The purpose of this paper is to share Qualcomm data on AP#85.25. This discussion paper provides Qualcomm’s internal ACLR measurement test data comparing Peak EIRP based ACLR and TRP based ACLR results. Discussion The ACLR measurement results performed using Qualcomm reference device are presented below: Observation 1: The Peak EIRP ACLR can be “liberal” compared to TRP ACLR by 1dB to 2dB. Observation 2: Compared to the ACLR TRP (relative) limit of 17dB, both Peak EIRP based and TRP based ACLR pass by significant margin. Observation 3: In general Qualcomm view is that ACLR test optimization can be achieved by using Peak EIRP as a test metric. Proposal 1: Use “ACLR test metric cha
